text:
zoe: Quick UX bug on small phones (<=375px) for the Activity table: when the sidebar collapses to icons the kebab menu of a row can be partially hidden behind the rail. Users reported "can't tap" in support.

martin: thanks — can you paste steps + device/browser?

zoe: repro: Console > Applications > Activity > shrink width to ~360px on mobile emulator (Chrome). Try tapping the kebab quickly on multiple rows. Sometimes the sidebar intercepts the touch, sometimes the popover is rendered off-screen. Screen capture: https://redwood-internal/u/360-kebab-clip.mp4

kai: probably a z-index/stacking context + transform issue. We added transform: translate3d for the rail to get smooth GPU scrolling, that creates a new stacking context.

sophie: design options: (A) make the kebab attach to body (popover escapes stacking), (B) switch to a centered floating menu for narrow widths, (C) change row actions into a single inline expand that reveals actions below the row.

zoe: also noticed text wrapping on the "Run again" label when width is tight — looks like "Run\nagain" and pushes layout. Might be better to use an icon-only control with accessible label.

martin: leaning toward option B (centered floating menu) because it keeps context and avoids focus-trap complexity of full-screen drawer. Centered popover also avoids being clipped by header on some devices.

kai: dev quick fix to prototype:
```css
/* force popovers to render into body and increase hit area */
.popover-root { position: fixed; z-index: 1000; }
.row .kebab { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; }
.app-rail { transform: none; /* remove heavy stacking context for now */ }
```

sophie: accessibility nits: if we go centered popover, it must be announced as "Menu for run {id}", trap focus while open, Esc returns focus to the kebab, and we must provide visible focus ring for keyboard users. Also avoid relying only on aria-describedby for hint text.

zoe: for the "Run again" label change, propose icon button with aria-label="Run again" + an inline sr-only full label. Visual label can be hidden at <=375 but shown at >=420.

martin: QA asks for visual snapshots at 320/360/375 widths and a cypress test for keyboard navigation opening the centered menu.

visual-tests: Percy snapshots queued: builds/9941/activity-320.png, builds/9941/activity-360.png, builds/9941/activity-375.png ✅

kai: i'll open a small PR that: - renders popovers into portal (body) - bumps kebab hit area - changes the Run button to icon-only on small widths with aria-label - adds the Percy snapshots. Tagging @sophie for a11y review.

sophie: will audit the PR. quick checklist: 1) keyboard trap + role=menu semantics, 2) announce live region if actions change, 3) check TalkBack/VoiceOver announcements.

zoe: one more micro-copy note: on tiny screens the "View details" label feels long; maybe shorten to "Details". Keep a11y text as full phrase.

martin: agreed — short visual label, full aria-label.

qa-bot: E2E test created: e2e/keyboard-activity-menu.spec.js ✅

zoe: nice work. I'll add the design variant for centered popover to the console kit and attach screenshots to the ticket.

kai: PR opened: github.com/redwood/console/pull/8822 — includes CSS prototype + portal popover.

martin: thanks — adding to design review agenda tomorrow. :thumbsup:
